draft_key_information_units.information: Total revenue increased organically by 8.6% to DKK 1,558m (reported growth of 3.2%), with Endoscopy Solutions accounting for 63% of revenue and Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring for 37%.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Revenue increased organically by 8.6% (19.5%) to DKK 1,558m (DKK 1,510m), with reported growth of 3.2% (20.4%).

draft_key_information_units.information: Endoscopy Solutions grew organically by 14.4%, primarily driven by Urology, ENT, & GI (21.0% organic growth) and Respiratory (8.3% organic growth).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Endoscopy Solutions grew by 14.4% organically, mainly driven by strong Urology, ENT, & GI growth of 21.0%. The Respiratory business group posted 8.3% organic growth.

draft_key_information_units.information: Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring reported flat organic growth of -0.1%, attributed to extraordinarily high comparable revenue from the prior-year quarter.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring posted flat organic growth of -0.1% (17.8%), reflecting an extraordinarily high revenue achieved in the same quarter last year.

draft_key_information_units.information: Regional organic growth varied: North America +9.8%, Europe +9.7%, and Rest of World -1.6% due to order fluctuations and high prior-year comparables.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Revenue growth was driven by solid organic growth in North America and Europe, respectively posting 9.8% (19.2%) and 9.7% (17.1%). Rest of World declined by -1.6% (28.0%).

draft_key_information_units.information: EBIT margin before special items was 10.5% (adjusted to 15.2% excluding tariff costs and FX headwinds), reflecting operational leverage offset by external factors.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: EBIT margin b.s.i. of 10.5%. Adjusting for tariff costs and FX, Ambu generated an EBIT margin of 15.2%.

draft_key_information_units.information: Free cash flow before acquisitions was DKK 13m, primarily impacted by elevated net working capital, FX headwinds, and tariff costs.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Free cash flow (FCF) before acquisitions totaled DKK 13m (DKK 69m). This was mainly negatively impacted by a change in net working capital... FCF was also impacted by both FX headwind and tariff costs.

draft_key_information_units.information: Ambu paid a dividend of DKK 90m (DKK 0.41 per share) and acquired DKK 38m of treasury shares as part of its share buyback program.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Ambu paid out DKK 90m in dividend in Q1... DKK 38m was used to acquire treasury shares in Q1 as part of Ambu’s share buyback program.

draft_key_information_units.information: Launched the portable SureSight Mobile video laryngoscope and extended the Ambu Recircle Program to include recycling of video laryngoscope blades in 2026.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Introduction of Ambu’s portable video laryngoscope solution, SureSight Mobile... Extension of the Ambu Recircle Program to include the collection and recycling of blades... in 2026.

draft_key_information_units.information: Maintained FY 2025/26 financial guidance: organic revenue growth of 10-13% and EBIT margin before special items of 12-14% (14-16% excluding tariff impacts).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: The 2025/26 financial guidance is maintained. Organic revenue growth: 10-13%. EBIT margin b.s.i.: 12-14% [14-16% excluding assumed impacts of tariffs].

evaluation.selection_rationale: Units cover headline financial performance (D1), major segment and regional dynamics (D2-D4), key profitability and cash flow developments (D5-D6), material financing activities (D7), significant strategic/product launches (D8), and forward guidance (D9). These align with priorities: financial performance, period-over-period changes, drivers, segment developments, liquidity, strategic moves, and guidance. Excluded routine boilerplate (governance, remuneration, risk lists, accounting policies) per instructions. Each unit represents an independently omittable material theme; no duplication or invented causal links. All facts are source-supported. Reference summary validates coverage of revenue, segments, regions, margins, cash flow, buybacks, guidance, and business highlights.
